summary.text:
# 对[From.GetName]的观测终止 / Observation of [From.GetName] Ceases

- 分类 Category: C8 银河轶事 / C8 Galactic miscellany · 来源 Sources: events/planet_destruction_events.txt:2967-3140; common/on_actions/01_planet_destruction.txt:182 on_destroy_planet_with_PLANET_KILLER_MAW; events/planet_destruction_events.txt:49-57 · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

任何巨像武器毁灭一颗带观测前哨的行星后一天（planet_destruction.100/200/300/700/800/1005 的“拆除观测站”分支），前哨所有者收到 planet_destruction.1000。

One day after any Colossus weapon destroys or changes a planet with an observation outpost (the "dismantle observation post" branch of planet_destruction.100/200/300/700/800/1005) the outpost owner receives planet_destruction.1000.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

正文随情形而变：自己毁掉了前哨所在的行星、行星被粉碎、被屏蔽、或被中子扫荡等；选项A拆除前哨；选项B仅限偏执/排外者在行星被粉碎时，拆除并每月获得团结。planet_destruction.1005（“被吞噬”）是巨像“巨胃”（Oversized Maw）吞噬行星的调度事件，同样触发此窗口。

The text varies: you destroyed the world yourself, it was shattered, shielded or swept; option A dismantles the outpost; option B (homicidal/xenophobe empires, planet shattered) dismantles it and grants monthly unity. planet_destruction.1005 ("Eaten") is the dispatcher of the Oversized Maw weapon and triggers the same window.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

本导读未单列条件差异；条件随各事件在上文说明，阅读器按文明设定显示可能的版本。/ This guide does not list conditions separately; they are described with each event above, and the reader shows the possible variants for the chosen empire profile.
